$comment: Local extension: upstream SAP abap-file-formats models SUSO (authorization object) without the DOKU 'UO' long text, the per-release TOBJVOR/TOBJVORDAT SAP_NEW data, TOBJ-FBLOCK/CONVERSION and the third (unset) criticality state, so a lossless pull/push round trip needs this local document. AFF section and enum names are kept where they map exactly; the deviating/added fields are documented in tmp/auth-family/designs/suso.md. Verified on S/4HANA SAP_BASIS 757: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /sap/abap_cli/auth/suso/<name>. Server-managed fields (TOBJ-BNAME, TOBJ_ATTR modifier/date/time, TOBJVOR modifier/date/time, package) are not part of the document.
title: Authorization Object Properties
description: ABAP authorization object (SU21, TOBJ* tables + DOKU UO long text) properties

header.title: Header
header.description: Object header (TOBJT short text + TOBJ_ATTR ABAP language version)

description.title: Description
description.description: Short text of the authorization object (TOBJT-TTEXT, XUTEXT CHAR 60) in originalLanguage.

originalLanguage.title: Original Language
originalLanguage.description: Two-letter ISO code of the short/long text language (language of the TOBJT and DOKU UO rows that are written).

abapLanguageVersion.title: ABAP Language Version
abapLanguageVersion.description: ABAP language version recorded in TOBJ_ATTR-ABAP_LANGUAGE_VERSION.

generalInformation.title: General Information
generalInformation.description: Authorization object class and legacy TOBJ flags

objectClass.title: Object Class
objectClass.description: TOBJ-OCLSS (XUOBJCLASS CHAR 4): authorization object class from TOBCT, e.g. AAAT for test objects. Delivered values are not blank-padded, so the field carries 1-4 characters (e.g. "AIF").

fieldBlock.title: Field Block
fieldBlock.description: TOBJ-FBLOCK (CHAR 8), delivered-object legacy flag; empty for ordinary objects.

authorizationFields.title: Authorization Fields
authorizationFields.description: Ordered TOBJ-FIEL1..FIEL0 (XUFIELD CHAR 10); at least one, at most ten.

authorizationField.title: Authorization Field
authorizationField.description: Authorization field name (AUTHX-FIELDNAME, e.g. ACTVT, BUKRS).

permittedActivities.title: Permitted Activities
permittedActivities.description: TACTZ-BROBJ/ACTVT rows (ACTIV_AUTH CHAR 2). Only meaningful when ACTVT is part of authorizationFields.

criticality.title: Criticality
criticality.description: TOBJVORFLG-FLAG3 (XUCRIT): critical objects cannot be set to 'No Authorization Check' by default.

classCopyToDefaultData.title: Classification for Copy to Default Data
classCopyToDefaultData.description: TOBJVORFLG-FLAG2 (SUSO_TRACE_FLAG) as used by SU22 trace data.
enumTitles: If application and object are in the same application component
If application and object are in the same software component
If application and object are in the same software package

sapNewRelevance.title: SAP New Relevance
sapNewRelevance.description: TOBJVORFLG-FLAG1 plus the per-release TOBJVOR/TOBJVORDAT proposal values.

values.title: SAP_NEW Values
values.description: TOBJVORDAT rows (per release, line and field value range).

lineNumber.title: Line Number
lineNumber.description: TOBJVORDAT-LFDNR (LFDNR CHAR 3), zeros padded on write.

classificationForCdsBdef.title: Classification for ABAP CDS Behavior Definitions

usageInOwnAuthContext.title: Usage in the OWN Authorization Context

usageInPrivilegedBdefMode.title: Usage in the Privileged BDEF Mode

longText.title: Long Text
longText.description: Documentation long text (DOKU id 'UO', object = authorization object name) as raw lines joined with '\n'; each line is at most 72 characters (DOKTL-DOKTEXT). SAPscript control lines such as &DEFINITION& are kept verbatim. An empty/absent value removes the documentation on write.
